patterns.description: Customers frequently report dissatisfaction with the quality of the food.
A significant number of reviews mention general negative experiences or unspecified issues.
Multiple customers report negative interactions or poor attitudes from staff members.
Customers express concerns about the pricing being too high or not offering good value.
There are complaints about long or unreasonable wait times for service or food.

root_causes.pattern: Customers frequently report dissatisfaction with the quality of the food.
root_causes.cause: Inconsistent food preparation, use of lower quality ingredients, or lack of proper quality control in the kitchen.

root_causes.pattern: Multiple customers report negative interactions or poor attitudes from staff members.
root_causes.cause: Insufficient staff training in customer service, high staff turnover, or inadequate management oversight of front-of-house operations.

root_causes.pattern: Customers express concerns about the pricing being too high or not offering good value.
root_causes.cause: Pricing strategy not aligned with customer expectations or perceived value, or high operational costs being passed directly to the consumer.

root_causes.pattern: There are complaints about long or unreasonable wait times for service or food.
root_causes.cause: Understaffing during peak hours, inefficient kitchen workflow, or poor table management leading to bottlenecks.

root_causes.pattern: A significant number of reviews mention general negative experiences or unspecified issues.
root_causes.cause: This broad category likely indicates a combination of the specific issues identified (food, staff, pricing, wait times) or other uncaptured minor frustrations that collectively contribute to a poor overall experience. It could also point to a general lack of attention to detail in the overall customer journey.
